description: This PHP source file defines the Doctrine class, responsible for setting up and managing Doctrine ORM configuration, including entity paths, cache, and database connection, in the OrangeHRM project.

classes.name: Doctrine
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for configuring and providing access to Doctrine ORM's EntityManager, including setting up cache, proxy classes, and database connection parameters.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Private constructor that initializes Doctrine ORM configuration, including cache setup, entity paths, proxy class generation settings, and database connection.

methods.name: isDevMode
methods.description: Determines if the application is running in development mode by checking the debug status of the kernel service.

methods.name: getPaths
methods.description: Retrieves entity paths from plugin directories to initialize ORM metadata configuration.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Implements singleton pattern for the Doctrine class, ensuring only one instance exists.

methods.name: getEntityManager
methods.description: Provides access to the configured Doctrine EntityManager instance.
